description: Cumulative fingerprints of verified production/preview issues. Sample window and repeated deployments are counted, not assumed to represent independent incidents. New evidence appended only by verified diagnostic runs.

observation_window.source: Cloudflare Pages deployment API and per-deployment build logs

categories.cause: Hall canonical IDs were added without matching standalone HTML on the same commit
categories.prevention: Require a complete canonical person-ID-to-profile-file reconciliation before build and release. Never hardcode old profile counts.

categories.signature: ValueError: Cannot add verified 2026 swimming result:
categories.cause: Release enrichment assumed a fixed bilingual legacy biography markup that did not match a new canonical profile
categories.prevention: Enrich by canonical person ID using format-aware sync; preserve historical profile bodies and fail early in CI for unsupported markup.

categories.signature: Literal backslash-n in visible HTML text node
categories.cause: HTML source contains literal JavaScript-style escaped newlines between link elements
categories.prevention: Check visible text nodes in source AND generated dist, block release and offer allowlisted patch before CI merge.

categories.signature: Expected all 682 profiles before accessibility audit
categories.cause: A11y test enforces historic 682-profile snapshot while current canonical Hall count is 760
categories.prevention: Derive count and exact IDs from current hall-of-fame-people.json rather than hardcoded total.

categories.signature: Failed: an internal error occurred; Failed to publish assets
categories.cause: Cloudflare Pages internal asset publication error after build phase (provider-origin error, not a verified source-code failure)
categories.prevention: Track unique deployment IDs, compare with subsequent builds of the same branch, inspect build logs before attempting any code change; do not retry indefinitely
categories.notes: Later preview deployments on the same branch succeeded. Keep separate from missing Hall profiles and Python build failures.

pending_actions: Activate recurring site smoke checks from GitHub Actions after merging the fix PR.
Implement safe known-fix PR workflow, no direct main commits.
Track log signatures over time with unique deployment IDs and avoid duplicate counting.
Keep Firecrawl functional browser checks and Cloudflare API deployments separate; HTTP 200 alone is not a runtime/browser pass.
Ensure fresh evidence is appended to the ledger when an error recurs instead of overwriting old history.

local_validation_incidents.scope: offline workflow reproduction; not a production observation
local_validation_incidents.cause: PR lookup runs in an if pipeline, which suppresses errexit; API failure is mistaken for no existing PR.
local_validation_incidents.fix: Assign successful lookup output before condition; stop on failure before Git writes.
local_validation_incidents.before: Two simulated API failures reproduced continuation toward push/PR creation.
local_validation_incidents.after: Three tests across both workflows pass: API error stops; existing PR stops; confirmed empty result allows proposal.
